title: CCC invites all model citizens to 40C3
summary: Chaos Computer Club (CCC) announces their 40th Chaos Communication Congress (40C3), inviting participants to Europe's premier hacker conference. The congress is a major annual gathering for hackers, privacy advocates, and digital rights activists.
problem_solved: Provides a platform for the hacker community to gather, share knowledge, and advocate for digital rights and privacy.
why_valuable: The Chaos Communication Congress has been instrumental in shaping hacker culture, exposing surveillance programs, and promoting digital freedom for over three decades.
